title: Galen Corpus Infrastructure: Digital-Coverage Census and Terminology Density Map (First1KGreek)
description: Reproducible infrastructure over the Galenic Greek corpus in First1KGreek. Phase 1: a structured digital-availability census (103 editions across 97 works, ~2.4M words of Greek) with CTS URNs, word counts, subject categories, and Scaife reader links. Phase 2 (new in v2.0): a config-driven terminology-density pipeline (odyCy lemmatization, log-likelihood keyness against a 19.7M-token non-Galen reference, LSJ cross-reference) producing a four-way classification of 12,538 lemmas along medical vs. non-medical Galen frequency axes and a prioritized punch list of 1,433 thin-gloss candidate terms, plus machine-bounded lemmatizer-accuracy measurements (Morpheus admissibility floor 89.5%; a 1,850-item gold standard mined from LSJ's own Galen citations, 62.3% on the rare stratum). Lemmatizer error is reported, never patched; no translation is made and no Greek word's meaning is adjudicated. Code MIT, data CC-BY-4.0.
